entities.summary: Bridget Elizabeth Carleton is a Canadian professional basketball player for the Portland Fire of the Women's National Basketball Association (WNBA) and USK Praha of the Czech Women's Basketball League. She played college basketball for the Iowa State Cyclones. She competes internationally with the Canada national team.
